metadata.coverageNotice: Artist open calls, residencies, and grants verified directly from official cultural foundations and institutional announcements.

opportunities.title: Khoj International Artists' Association Residency 2026-2027
opportunities.description: 6-week intensive residency for visual artists, researchers, and multidisciplinary practitioners investigating ecology, urban commons, and community-engaged art practices. Includes private studio space, curatorial mentoring, and a public open-studio presentation.
opportunities.stipendOrAwardText: INR 75,000 production stipend + accommodation and studio at Khoj Studios, Khirki Extension
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Open to visual artists and cultural researchers based in South Asia or working with South Asian themes. Minimum 3 years of independent practice.

opportunities.title: Serendipity Arts Foundation Visual Arts Production Grant 2026
opportunities.description: Production grants supporting artists and curators to develop new, large-scale visual and public art projects for showcase during the annual Serendipity Arts Festival in Panaji, Goa.
opportunities.stipendOrAwardText: Production grants ranging from INR 2,00,000 to INR 5,00,000 + project fabrication support
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Open to emerging and mid-career artists, sculptors, installation artists, and digital creators residing across South Asia.

opportunities.title: Gasworks International Artists' Residency (South Asia Fellowship)
opportunities.description: Fully funded 11-week residency in London for an artist based in South Asia. Includes 24-hour studio access at Gasworks, accommodation in London, return economy flights, weekly per diem, and material production budget.
opportunities.stipendOrAwardText: Return flights, private room, £240/week living allowance + £800 material budget
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Open to self-identifying visual artists living and working in India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal, or Sri Lanka.

opportunities.title: Delfina Foundation Residency: Collecting as Practice & Research
opportunities.description: International thematic residency exploring contemporary art collecting, institutional provenance, archive methodologies, and public patronage.
opportunities.stipendOrAwardText: Fully funded accommodation, return airfare, weekly stipend of £300, and institutional visits
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Open to curators, contemporary art writers, and visual artists with an established critical research portfolio.

opportunities.title: Students' Biennale National Open Call — Kochi Biennale Foundation
opportunities.description: Nationwide call for fine arts students and recent art school graduates across India to exhibit site-responsive installations and contemporary works during the Kochi-Muziris Biennale collateral programme in Fort Kochi.
opportunities.stipendOrAwardText: Exhibition production grant, freight assistance, and round-trip travel to Kochi for install
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Enrolled BFA/MFA students or graduates within 2 years of completing an accredited visual arts degree in India.

opportunities.title: British Council: Connections Through Culture India-UK Creative Grants
opportunities.description: Bilateral development grants designed to foster international artistic collaboration, co-creation, and exchange between creative practitioners and cultural organisations in the UK and India.
opportunities.stipendOrAwardText: Grants of up to £10,000 (approx. INR 10.8 Lakhs) to co-develop joint art research and installations
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Joint proposals submitted by at least one UK artist/institution and one Indian artist/collective.

opportunities.title: India Art Fair Digital Artist in Residence Open Call
opportunities.organiser: India Art Fair / The Art Mumbai Co.
opportunities.description: Commission and residency for artists working with generative code, 3D modelling, extended reality (XR), and interactive digital media. Selected artworks will be unveiled on dedicated interactive displays at the next India Art Fair pavilion.
opportunities.stipendOrAwardText: INR 3,50,000 commission honorarium + tech hardware stipend & fair exhibition booth showcase
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Open to contemporary artists of Indian nationality or diaspora working at the intersection of fine art and technology.

opportunities.title: Académie de France à Rome — Villa Medici Visual Arts Fellowship
opportunities.description: Year-long prestigious residential fellowship at Villa Medici in Rome for visual artists, designers, and art historians. Includes historical studio residence, exhibition opportunities, and curatorial exchange.
opportunities.stipendOrAwardText: Monthly living allowance of approx. €3,000 + private on-site studio apartment at Villa Medici
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Open to international artists, sculptors, and creative practitioners with a proven record of notable exhibitions.
